name: Family Tree
summary: Cliffwatcher Longhorn sends you to Ghost Walker Post with news of unusual centaur activity. His brother is there in Desolace.

sections.title: A Report for a Brother
sections.body: Cliffwatcher Longhorn asks you to carry a report to his brother, Nataka, at Ghost Walker Post in Desolace. A year has passed since his last letter. Now the centaurs are acting unusually, and Nataka needs to hear what is happening.

sections.title: The Way There
sections.body: From Thousand Needles, travel to Stonetalon Mountain, north of the Crossroads. Go west into the Charred Vale, then south into Desolace. Follow the road south to Ghost Walker Post.

sections.title: A Welcome at the Post
sections.body: Nataka Longhorn welcomes you to Ghost Walker Post. He cannot say how you know Cliffwatcher, but his brother seems to trust you. The post has plenty of needs, so Nataka suggests speaking with the others there. One of them may need your help.

faq.q: Who is Cliffwatcher Longhorn trying to contact?
faq.answer: Cliffwatcher Longhorn is trying to contact his brother, Nataka Longhorn, at Ghost Walker Post in Desolace.

faq.q: Why is Cliffwatcher Longhorn sending a report now?
faq.answer: Cliffwatcher has not written for a year, and the centaurs have been acting unusually. Nataka needs to hear about it.
Nataka Longhorn is at Ghost Walker Post in Desolace, reached by a road running south.

faq.q: What path leads to Ghost Walker Post from Thousand Needles?
faq.answer: From Thousand Needles, travel to Stonetalon Mountain, north of the Crossroads. Go west into the Charred Vale, then south into Desolace and follow the road to Ghost Walker Post.
